# Cully v0.8.3

Protect saved Cully MCP tool/source counts during a live binary upgrade. An older running wrapper can rewrite its original state schema and discard fields introduced by a newer hook binary. The richer counters now have a private, atomic thread-scoped snapshot, read under the shared state lock and restored on resume. Existing call totals remain intact while that wrapper is still open.

This retains the v0.8.2 combined foreground/advisor/startup counts, complete named-tool breakdown and semantic recall count, together with v0.8.1's tighter spacing and automatic resume restoration. Reopen with `cully codex resume` to load the updated renderer.

Validation: formatting, vet and the full race suite, including a regression that simulates an older wrapper dropping newer fields between calls and checks preservation, continued accumulation, resume and owner-readable permissions. An opt-in live Codex check verifies that an actual semantic Cully call reaches the linked advisor counter without changing foreground activity.
